in_marathi.name: Devaraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devaraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devaraj is a compound name derived from two roots: Deva (God) and Raja (King). It signifies a ruler or king of the gods. The name is associated with power, divinity, and royalty in Hindu mythology.
